resources.description: Vietnam Northern traditional lottery results (XSMB / Xo So Mien Bac): full prize table from special prize (giai dac biet) to 7th prize for the latest daily draws at 18:15 Hanoi time. Structured JSON, updated within minutes of the draw. Used by millions of Vietnamese daily.

Next draw times for major lotteries worldwide: US Powerball, Mega Millions, Vietnam Vietlott Power 6/55, Mega 6/45 and Vietnamese regional lotteries XSMB/XSMN/XSMT. Returns the next upcoming draw datetime in UTC for each game. Perfect for reminder bots and countdown widgets.
